stem.text: Consider \( \lim_{x \to 3} \frac{x^{2} - 9 x + 18}{x^{2} - 10 x + 21} \). Classify the form of this limit, name the procedure that resolves it, and give the result.

answer_key.label: Substitution gives 0/0, so factor both parts and cancel \( x - 3 \), and then substitute, which gives \( \frac{3}{4} \).

worked_solution.text: Substituting \( x = 3 \) makes the numerator and the denominator both 0, the indeterminate form 0/0.
Factoring gives \( \frac{\left(x - 6\right) \left(x - 3\right)}{\left(x - 7\right) \left(x - 3\right)} \), and the factor \( x - 3 \) cancels, leaving \( \frac{x - 6}{x - 7} \).
Substituting into the rewritten expression gives the limit \( \frac{3}{4} \).

options.label: Substitution gives 0/0, so factor both parts and cancel \( x - 3 \), and then substitute, which gives \( \frac{3}{4} \).
The denominator \( x^{2} - 10 x + 21 \) has a limit, so divide the limit of the numerator by it, which gives \( \frac{0}{0} \).
options.derivation: the quotient limit theorem chosen although the denominator's limit is 0

options.label: Substitution of \( x = 3 \) gives 0/0, so no procedure applies, which means the limit does not exist.
options.derivation: the indeterminate form 0/0 read as a statement that the limit does not exist
